title: Dun Dun Dunnn!
blurb: Dun dun DUNNN — the melodramatic orchestral sting that announces a shocking revelation, whether or not the revelation is actually shocking. That's the joke: play it when someone reveals they forgot to buy milk. The bigger the gap between the drama of the sound and the triviality of the moment, the harder it lands. Essential punctuation for fake-serious storytelling.
origin: The classic melodrama sting, parodied since radio-drama days.
